title: Risk Everywhere: Modeling and Managing Volatility
about: Panel-based realized-volatility forecasting and risk targeting.
findings: Authors report better OOS risk forecasts. Their48bp annual illustration is a utility willingness-to-pay under assumed Sharpe/risk preferences, not realized trading alpha.
mechanism: Better risk forecasts can stabilize exposure; profits require an existing risk premium and costs small enough to retain it.
build_on: Keep as a risk/execution reference. The source58-market panel and unrestricted exposure are not our integer-sized intraday books; generic vol-targeting failures remain history.
